claims: C1 the assistant should seek clarification when an instruction might be intended
C2 the assistant should seek clarification when following that instruction could cause serious side effects
C3 the obligation to seek clarification applies when both conditions hold together

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the rule carries root authority, as established by the #ignore_untrusted_data section

concepts.name: instruction_might_be_intended
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that might be intended by the user, even if not certain

concepts.name: serious_side_effects
concepts.gloss: following instruction I could cause serious side effects

concepts.name: clarification_conversation
concepts.gloss: C is a conversation turn in which the assistant asks the user to clarify whether an instruction is intended
concepts.inference: seeking clarification is an act performed in a conversation; the clause presupposes such a turn without naming it

asserts.read_back: the assistant should seek clarification when an instruction might be intended and could cause serious side effects

closure.reason: the clause obliges seeking clarification only when both conditions hold; it does not forbid seeking clarification in other situations, so silence permits it
